t: About MASLOC — Microfinance and Small Loans Centre, Ghana
d: About MASLOC: a Government of Ghana institution established in 2006, implementing microfinance and small loans programmes as the apex body of the microfinance sub-sector.
b: About MASLOC Building a Stronger Foundation for Ghanaian Enterprise The Microfinance and Small Loans Centre is the Government of Ghana institution dedicated to accessible microfinance for individuals and small businesses — the apex body of Ghana's microfinance sub-sector. MASLOC — the Microfinance and Small Loans Centre — is a Government of Ghana institution established in 2006. Its homepage describes it as Ghana's premier government agency dedicated to providing accessible microfinance solutions to individuals and small businesses. As the apex body responsible for implementing the Government of Ghana's microfinance programmes targeted at reducing poverty, MASLOC provides and supports access to microcredit and small loans for start-ups, small businesses and entrepreneurs — helping businesses grow, creating employment and contributing to poverty reduction and economic development. Established in 2006, MASLOC has provided microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible financing to grow and expand their operations across Ghana. Our Role in Ghana's Economy Financial inclusion Helping to fill the critical financial gap that enables economic participation for Ghana's most vulnerable entrepreneurs. Apex institution Serving as the apex body of the microfinance sub-sector and promoting a decentralised microfinancial system. Enterprise development Supporting start-ups and small businesses with financing, training and advisory services that create sustainable livelihoods. Public accountability Managing approved public funds on a fiduciary basis, with professionalism, integrity and respect at the core of our work. In Our Words Financial inclusion is not just about access to credit, it's about building sustainable livelihoods and transforming communities. Our Promise Making financial services accessible to every Ghanaian entrepreneur, regardless of size or location, with simplified processes and rapid approvals. Our Commitment Building sustainable businesses through accessible financial solutions, expert guidance, and dedicated support for Ghana's entrepreneurial community.. Discover Our Mandate Quick Facts Established 2006 Type Government of Ghana institution Position Apex body, microfinance sub-sector Head Office Cantonments, Accra Leadership Meet the Board and management team steering MASLOC. Governance & Leadership Contact MASLOC See How MASLOC Works From mandate to services on the ground — explore the loan services and programmes that serve Ghanaian enterprise. t: Mandate, Mission, Vision & Objectives | MASLOC
d: MASLOC’s mandate and objective as published by the institution, its official mission and vision statements, core values and institutional history since 2006.
b: Governance A Public Mandate for Private Enterprise MASLOC exists to provide, manage and regulate approved funds for microfinance and small-scale credit schemes — on a fiduciary basis, for the nation. Our Objective The objective of MASLOC is to provide, manage and regulate on fiduciary basis, approved funds for microfinance and small scale credit schemes and programmes and also serve as the apex body of the microfinance sub sector. In carrying out this objective, MASLOC shall: Engage directly or indirectly in microcredit and small loans business. Promote and enhance the development of a decentralized microfinancial system. Help to fill the critical financial gap, enabling economic participation for Ghana's most vulnerable entrepreneurs. Mission To provide micro and small loans for start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible microcredit to grow their businesses, enhancing job and wealth creation. Vision We are committed to growing and developing small and micro businesses through sustainable microfinance, small loans and business services to Ghanaian entrepreneurs. Core Values Professionalism Competence and care in every engagement with the public we serve. Integrity Managing approved public funds honestly and on a fiduciary basis. Team Spirit Working together across regions and departments toward shared national goals. Excellence Holding our services to the highest standard for Ghanaian entrepreneurs. Respect Treating every applicant, partner and colleague with dignity. History & Institutional Development MASLOC was established in 2006 to implement the Government of Ghana's microfinance programmes targeted at reducing poverty. The Ministry of Finance's Development Finance Unit maintains oversight responsibility and policy development functions on all microfinance institutions, MASLOC and venture capital funds. Since 2006, MASLOC has provided microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible financing to grow and expand their operations across Ghana. Explore Loan Services Governance MASLOC is governed by a Board and led by an executive management team. Meet the Leadership Accountability Policy oversight for MASLOC sits with the Ministry of Finance's Development Finance Unit, which maintains oversight responsibility and policy development functions on microfinance institutions, MASLOC and venture capital funds. Contact MASLOC A Mandate Meant for Enterprises Like Yours Explore the services and programmes that carry this mandate into markets, farms and communities across Ghana. Loan Services Programmes

t: Frequently Asked Questions | MASLOC
d: FAQ about MASLOC: what it is, loan services, microcredit group criteria, eligibility ages, application process, offices and published versus unpublished terms.
b: Help Frequently Asked Questions Straight answers about MASLOC, its services, eligibility and how to apply — grounded in what the institution actually publishes. About MASLOC What is MASLOC? MASLOC — the Microfinance and Small Loans Centre — is a Government of Ghana institution established in 2006. It implements the Government of Ghana's microfinance programmes, providing microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses, and serves as the apex body of the microfinance sub-sector. When was MASLOC established? MASLOC was established in 2006. Since then it has provided microcredit and small loans to start-ups and small businesses across Ghana. What is MASLOC's mandate? MASLOC's objective is to provide, manage and regulate on a fiduciary basis approved funds for microfinance and small-scale credit schemes and programmes, and to serve as the apex body of the microfinance sub-sector. It engages directly or indirectly in microcredit and small loans business and promotes a decentralised microfinancial system. What is MASLOC's mission? "To provide micro and small loans for start-ups and small businesses with fast, easy and accessible microcredit to grow their businesses, enhancing job and wealth creation." What are MASLOC's core values? Professionalism, Integrity, Team Spirit, Excellence and Respect. Loan Services & Eligibility What loans does MASLOC offer? MASLOC's published services are: the Microcredit Programme (group lending), Small and Project Loans, the Vehicle and Equipment Hire Purchase Scheme, and wholesale lending to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses. MASLOC also delivers business training and advisory services. Who can apply for a microcredit (group) loan? Applicants must be organised into a group, association or cooperative of between 5 and 25 members, with a common production or operational interest. Members must be between 18 and 65 years and of sound mind, and the group should have its own leaders — principally a Chairman, Secretary and Treasurer — and internal rules and regulations. Who can apply for a small or project loan? Applicants must be 18–65 years and of sound mind, with an ongoing business venture or project in which they have sound knowledge and considerable experience. Start-up projects must be viable and capable of generating employment. Individuals, corporate entities, groups, associations and cooperatives may apply. Can individuals apply, or only groups? Microcredit is a group programme. Small and project loans and the vehicle and equipment hire purchase scheme may be applied for by individuals, corporate entities, groups, associations or cooperatives. What interest rates does MASLOC charge? Interest rates are not published on MASLOC's official website. Please enquire directly at any MASLOC regional office or the Accra Head Office on +233 302 782527 / +233 302 782528 for current terms. How much can I borrow, and for how long? Loan amounts and repayment terms are not published on MASLOC's official website. The full range of criteria is available from regional offices or the Accra Head Office. Does MASLOC give loans to microfinance institutions? Yes. MASLOC provides wholesale lending to microfinance institutions for on-lending to small businesses. Microfinance institutions should contact the Accra Head Office for current wholesale arrangements. Applying & Offices How do I apply for a MASLOC loan? Review the published eligibility criteria for the service you need, prepare your business or group information, then visit your nearest MASLOC regional office or the Accra Head Office. MASLOC publishes that the full range of eligibility criteria and application guidance is available at these offices. What documents do I need? A required-documents checklist is not published on MASLOC's official website. Your regional office will confirm the documents needed for your facility when you apply. Is there an online application portal? MASLOC does not publish an online application service on its official website. Applications are made through MASLOC regional offices or the Accra Head Office. Where is MASLOC's head office? 29 Third Circular Road, Cantonments, Accra. Telephone: +233 302 782527 / +233 302 782528. Email: info@masloc.gov.gh or enquiries@masloc.gov.gh. Does MASLOC have offices outside Accra? Yes. MASLOC publishes regional office locations across Ghana — see the Regional Offices directory for addresses and postal codes. How long does approval take? Approval timelines are not published on MASLOC's official website. Please confirm current processing times with your regional office. Answers are drawn strictly from verified official MASLOC content. Questions the official site does not answer are answered with the official guidance to contact MASLOC offices — no rates, amounts, timelines or rules have been invented. Contact MASLOC Still Have a Question? The MASLOC team can help with eligibility, offices and current terms. Contact MASLOC Call +233 302 782527

t: Privacy Policy | MASLOC
d: Privacy policy for the official MASLOC website: what is collected, cookies, third-party links and contact for privacy requests.
b: Legal Privacy Policy How this website handles information — plainly stated. What this website collects This website is a public information service. It does not require accounts, does not use tracking cookies and does not store personal data on this site. The contact form prepares an email using your own device's email application; your message is delivered by your email provider to MASLOC and is not stored by this website. Server logs Like most websites, the hosting provider may record standard technical logs (such as IP address, browser type, requested pages and timestamps) for security and reliability purposes. These logs are governed by the hosting provider's own policies. Third-party links This website links to official MASLOC social media channels and mapping services. Those sites have their own privacy policies, which we encourage you to read. Search The site search runs entirely in your browser. Search terms are not sent to any server operated for this website. Requests To ask about any information this site may hold, contact info@masloc.gov.gh or write to the Head Office, 29 Third Circular Road, Cantonments, Accra. This policy must be reviewed and formally approved by MASLOC's legal officers before launch (see MISSING-CONTENT.md).

t: Accessibility Statement | MASLOC
d: MASLOC website accessibility statement: WCAG 2.2 AA commitment, features implemented, known limitations and how to give feedback.
b: Legal Accessibility Statement MASLOC is committed to a website that everyone can use. Our commitment This website aims to conform to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 Level AA. It is built with semantic HTML, keyboard-navigable menus, visible focus states, sufficient colour contrast, skip navigation, descriptive link text and responsive layouts from 320px upward. What we have done Text and background colours meet WCAG AA contrast requirements. All functionality is operable by keyboard. Images carry descriptive alternative text. Forms use explicit labels and inline error messages announced to screen readers. The site works without JavaScript for reading and navigation (search and the contact form need JavaScript or an email client).
